source.license_status: repository-owned source; no third-party code is transferred

preconditions: input format is finite typed relationship graph 1
edge types and provenance classes are declared by the input vocabulary
certainty is exactly the JSON integer 1; booleans and floating-point 1.0 are invalid
theorem-backed implicative, synonymous, and part-whole edges name backing source evidence
canonical edge identities (type, source, target, provenance, use_site) are unique after exact-duplicate collapse

normal_form.nodes: sorted by kind group (claim, alias, assumption_set), then identifier
normal_form.edges: exact duplicates collapse; remaining edges are sorted by declared edge-type order, source, target, provenance, and use_site; conflicting payloads under one canonical edge identity are refused
normal_form.object_encoding: canonical JSON with recursively lexicographic object keys
